budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Each steward deposits six fruits at their own storehouse while preserving or restoring the shared orchard network; fruit can instead be invested or gifted.
task.natural_termination: Success when all stores reach six; collapse when every root is zero and every carried fruit is zero without success. Otherwise horizon 128 truncates. An ecologically stranded state not matching collapse can persist to the horizon.
task.interaction: Agents compete for local fruit, spend their own potential income on root/soil restoration, propagate moisture and seed support to neighbouring patches on delayed four-step pulses, and can transfer fruit only to willing adjacent receivers.
task.observation_access: Fully observable map, all positions, inventories, banks, local ecological stocks and roots/moisture, terminal causes and actual event flags. All entity masks are true; every float32 observation is an integer feature divided by 256.

native_event_definitions.meaning: All three personal storehouse quotas satisfied
All roots and carried planting fruit exhausted without success
Roles that actually harvested one fruit this transition
Roles that actually invested one fruit in an orchard this transition
Roles that actually irrigated a rooted patch this transition
Roles that actually gave one fruit to a receiving partner this transition
Roles that actually deposited fruit this transition
Patch ids that grew one fruit on this ecological pulse

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
